$comment: MACHINE-READABLE SCHEMA-AUTHORITY CONTRACT. Enforced by test/schemaAuthority.test.ts. A path under db/ that bears schema-definition material and is not classified here FAILS CLOSED — it may not become competing authority by simply appearing.

bootstrap_authority.description: The only canonical virgin-install base. Generated from the verified afterworth-dev live-state snapshot plus hashed catalog captures.
bootstrap_authority.rolling_rationale: VERSION 0060 is a FIXED CUTOVER BASE. Future schema change is layered as db/migrations/0061+, never folded back into the bootstrap. A rolling snapshot would make the bootstrap's version a moving target, so a virgin install and an upgraded install would no longer be provably the same schema — which is the single property this whole model exists to guarantee.

future_migration_authority.description: Authoritative schema change after bootstrap version 0060. Applies to BOTH a virgin bootstrap and an installation that traversed the real history.
future_migration_authority.rule: No future migration may be numbered at or below the bootstrap cutoff. Legitimate future migrations begin at 0061. VERSION is a statement about what the bootstrap PRODUCES, never a ceiling on migration numbers in the repository.

historical_migrations.description: Immutable record for installations that actually traversed it. NEVER executed during a virgin bootstrap: the bootstrap already contains their outcome, and these files cannot build from zero anyway (proven — they fail on 0001).
protections: no new file may be added at or below the cutoff
the range is fully occupied 60/60, so both rules cover any addition

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Current-state DDL captured 2026-07-10, roughly forty migrations into the schema's life. Predates db/bootstrap and was never a complete base — it holds 17 of 41 live tables.
non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: It is a partial historical capture, not a mirror of current state. Requiring equivalence would force edits to a legacy artifact every time the schema moves, for no consumer that needs it. What IS enforced: it can never SUPPLY an object missing from db/bootstrap.
non_authoritative_paths.removal_prerequisite: Port reconFiduciaryAuthority.mjs and the three tests onto db/bootstrap, then delete. Not done here: removing files to reduce duplication is not a reason to remove them.

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Hand-maintained function bodies that are the SOURCE for db/bundles/*.sql deployment slices and for the SQL-authorization harness. Actively consumed; removing it would break 15 bundle builders and the 469-assertion authorization suite.

consumers.note: SQL-authorization suite loads named function files
drift verifier for deployed function bodies
several suites read specific function files

non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: These bodies are deployed via bundles to an already-live database; db/bootstrap builds a virgin one. Both derive from the same live state today. Enforced instead: db/functions can never SUPPLY a function missing from db/bootstrap, so it cannot make reconciliation appear complete.
non_authoritative_paths.removal_prerequisite: Re-source the bundle builders and the SQL-auth harness from db/bootstrap/60_functions.sql. Substantial, and out of scope here.

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Deployment slices generated from db/functions by scripts/build*Bundle.mjs. Every file carries 'GENERATED ... DO NOT EDIT'.
non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: Must match its own generator input (enforced by CI 'git diff --exit-code' after regeneration), not db/bootstrap.
non_authoritative_paths.removal_prerequisite: None planned — this is the live deployment path for an existing installation.

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Test preambles. db/tests/preamble_real_auth.sql holds the only CREATE TABLE for beneficiaries and notifications outside db/bootstrap — which is exactly why it must never count as a schema source.
non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: A minimal test model, deliberately not production shape.
non_authoritative_paths.removal_prerequisite: None — it is test infrastructure and should stay.

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Local platform shim fabricating auth.users/storage.objects for container runs. Must never be read as application-owned schema.
non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: It fakes a platform it does not own; equivalence with anything is meaningless.
non_authoritative_paths.removal_prerequisite: A Supabase-local stack replacing the vanilla-Postgres container.

non_authoritative_paths.reason: Out-of-band delta applied to the live database.
Hand-maintained table GRANTs for the live database; db/bootstrap/100_grants.sql is the canonical virgin equivalent.
non_authoritative_paths.drift_rationale: Deployment-path artifact for an existing installation.

hosted_compatibility.blocked_by: R-02 — no non-production Supabase environment exists
requires_proof: CREATE EVENT TRIGGER ensure_rls under a hosted Supabase migration role
migration metadata / cutover behaviour (whether supabase_migrations.schema_migrations must be pre-seeded so the CLI does not attempt 0001-0060)
extension creation privileges for pgcrypto and uuid-ossp under the hosted role
ownership statements (ALTER ... OWNER TO postgres) under the hosted role
hosted_compatibility.note: Local container success does NOT clear any of these. The containers grant superuser; hosted Supabase does not.
